task: Find a course on Coursera about 'Artificial Intelligence Ethics', which has a duration of less than 5 weeks and has been rated 4.5 stars or higher. Provide the course name and the instructor's name.
answer: FINAL: Artificial Intelligence: Ethics & Societal Challenges — instructor: Maria Hedlund (Lund University). Coursera lists a 4.7/5 rating from 433 reviews and a flexible duration of 1 week at 10 hours per week, meeting both requirements. Source: https://www.coursera.org/learn/ai-ethics (accessed October 27, 2026). Evidence: final.png.
